items.title: Citigroup (C) Sets Post GFC Record With $817 Million Multifamily CMBS Deal
items.summary: Citigroup priced an $817 million multifamily only CMBS conduit, the largest of its kind for the bank since the global financial crisis. This transaction highlights Citi's role as a key lender in US commercial real estate securitization.
